preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the binary string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the binary string s must be exactly 2n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The binary string s must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in map(int, input().split())) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output the length of b and the indices of b.

postconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p_i <= 2 * n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output n distinct indices p_i for the partition.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i != p_j for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: The indices in p must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i != b_j for i in range(len(b)) for j in range(i + 1, len(b)))
postconditions.description: The indices in b must be distinct.
